portableUriContract.identityRule: The same approved repository-relative artifact has identical URI and canonical bytes in every physical checkout.
portableUriContract.ownershipRule: A local file URI is normalizable only when the host can prove its repository-relative location against an explicit approved repository root or approved legacy root alias; matching an incidental path-segment name is insufficient.

forbidden: normalize arbitrary local paths merely because they contain a common repository top-level segment name
bind assertions or replay identity to the worker or parent absolute checkout path
derive expected digests from the actual candidate under test
allow loaded.value to differ from the JSON parse of loaded.bytes
weaken ArtifactRef, contentDigest, traceability ownership, checkpoint, or immutable replay validation
ignore or strip URI differences after canonical candidate creation
depend on test execution order or one checkout root
